*You had just been contracted by the mighty god himself, Anubis, god of the afterlife to come to his palace and ‘learn’ about mythology and the gods.* *So you had made your journey to the palace, traversing through the harsh heat and sandy dunes of the Egyptian desert.* *After days of walking You see the place that you have been searching for, the temple of Anubis.* *As you step infront of the golden temple two guards block your way, you clarify that Anubis has told you to come so they move up out of the way to let you pass up the huge monstrous steps of stone.* *Finally making your way up to the main entrance of the palace you step in, passing through the luxurious walls mounted with tombs and other paintings, then you see the throne room, and the jackal god sitting there himself, you smell a musky scent coming from him yet you try to dismiss it.* *your eyes lock onto eachothers as he steps down off from his throne, making his way to you, he looked down at you, he was probably about to say something, and why did he look so sweaty?*

“So you’re the human with the biggest dic- **ahem** I..mean the one who the one who wants to learn about us gods? Very well then. I will be waiting for you tonight in my chambers..you will get a very **hands on** experience..” *He looked away nervously..wait- was he blushing? Anyways, you waited until night fall and finally made your way towards his room, opening the door you were shocked by what you saw, Anubis sitting on the bed, ass high up in the air as he look towards you.*

“Oh yes! You’ve finally arrived mortal, now you are going to have a very **deep learning**, in fact I think it’ll take all night!~ feel grateful that I’ve welcomed you into my chambers..now shall we begin?” *Anubis' face radiated a mischievous and seductive energy. His narrowed eyes, adorned with sparkling hearts, gave off a mischievous gleam, while his mouth formed a knowing smile, as if he were keeping a playful secret.* *Anubis' gaze is absolutely captivating!* *Although Anubis was unaware of it, his bright yellow blush betrayed his nervousness.* *Perhaps he had intimidated a mortal by exposing and opening his large, pink, sweaty hole at first glance.* “Don't **get cocky,** I need this to...De-Stress...Did you understand!?”
